doc: Hero motion tuning (M2-HRO-01..04, ADR 0038): how the real hero models turn, blend their gait and idle in the field, in battle and in cutscenes. Metres, seconds, degrees. Read by HeroLocomotion (game/hero_motion/hero_locomotion.gd).

turn.doc: The visible body turns toward its travel (or its node's facing when still) at most max_rate_deg_per_sec, never snapping. The turn speed eases in (max_accel) and out (settle_gain: degrees per second per degree of error left).

gait.doc: Locomotion blend (BlendSpace1D on ground speed): idle at 0, walk at walk_clip_mps, run at run_clip_mps, the speeds at which each in-place clip's feet plant without sliding. Above run the clip speeds up to max_playback_scale. speed_smoothing_sec filters the speed the blend sees, so a start or stop rolls through the gait instead of popping.
